map.根据温室几何尺寸与目标换气次数，估算所需通风量与风机配置。: From greenhouse geometry and target air changes, estimate ventilation demand and fan configuration.
map.截面积 = 宽 × 檐高 + 宽 × (脊高 − 檐高) ÷ 2；体积 = 截面: Section area = width x eave height + width x (ridge height - eave height) / 2; volume = section area x length; ventilation = volume x air changes; fans = ceil(ventilation / per-fan flow)
map.双坡屋面温室截面积按「矩形 + 三角形」拆分：檐高以下为矩形，脊高与檐高之差的一: Gable-roof greenhouse section area splits into "rectangle + triangle": below eave is rectangle, half the ridge-eave difference is triangle. Ventilation = volume x target air changes (per hour); ventilation per m² = ventilation / floor area to check sufficiency; enter per-fan flow to estimate fan count by rounding up.
map.💡 公式：温室体积 = (宽度 × 檐高 + 宽度 × (脊高 − 檐高) ÷: 💡 Formula: Greenhouse volume = (width x eave height + width x (ridge height - eave height) / 2) x length; ventilation = volume x air changes
map.夏季高温时，温室换气次数通常取 20–60 次/小时，具体依作物与地区而定: In summer heat, air changes usually 20-60 per hour, depending on crop and region
map.计算结果为基础理论值，实际配置需考虑风压损失、进风口面积与风机效率: Result is a basic theoretical value; actual config must consider wind-pressure loss, inlet area, and fan efficiency
map.通风量 = 温室体积 × 换气次数（次/h）。: Ventilation = greenhouse volume x air changes (per h).
map.夏季降温常需 30~60 次/h 换气，冬季维持 1~3 次/h 除湿。: Summer cooling often needs 30-60 air changes/h; winter keeps 1-3/h for dehumidification.
map.温室体积 2000 m³，夏季目标换气 40 次/h，则所需通风量 = 2000: Volume 2000 m³, summer target 40 air changes/h, ventilation = 2000 x 40 = 80,000 m³/h. Two 40,000 m³/h fans suffice; verify pad-fan velocity.
map.换气次数越高越好吗？: Is more air changes always better?
map.夏季降温需要高换气，但冬季高换气会散热增耗、引发冷害。应随季节与作物调整，并配合: Summer cooling needs high air changes, but winter high air changes lose heat and risk cold damage. Adjust by season and crop, with thermal screens.
map.自然通风和机械通风怎么选？: How to choose natural vs mechanical ventilation?
map.自然通风节能但受风压温差限制，适合春秋；夏季高温高湿地区机械（风机+湿帘）更稳。: Natural ventilation saves energy but is limited by wind and temperature difference, good for spring/autumn; in hot-humid summer, mechanical (fan + pad) is steadier. Design often combines both.
